entities.name: Cho-Manno
entities.description: Spiritual and political leader of the Cho-Arrim on Mercadia and follower of the Ramos mythology.

entities.name: Cho-Arrim
entities.description: People of Mercadia led by Cho-Manno, pushed out of their ancestral lands by the Kyren.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: Plane where the Cho-Arrim rebelled against the Kyren.

entities.name: Kyren
entities.description: Ruling masters of Mercadia who oppressed the Cho-Arrim and were overthrown and exiled.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Ship whose crew helped Cho-Manno free his people.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: Healer who fell in love with Cho-Manno, cured the Phyrexian plague and later married him.

entities.name: Revolution on Mercadia
entities.description: Uprising that overthrew and exiled the ruling Kyren.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion of Dominaria in which Orim cured the Phyrexian plague.

events.summary: Cho-Manno guides the Cho-Arrim in rebellion against the Mercadians and Kyren masters.
events.quote: Cho-Manno guided his people in their rebellion against the oppression of the Mercadians

events.summary: The Weatherlight crew helps free the Cho-Arrim and Cho-Manno falls in love with Orim.
events.quote: he fell in love with Orim while they did

events.summary: Orim is taken by Karn to Mercadia and marries Cho-Manno; they have a daughter, Oriss.
events.quote: Orim was taken by Karn to Mercadia, where she married Cho-Manno
